assertions.assertion: Code defines a GoogleIdentityProvider class that extends IdentityProvider with a 'google' provider type constant
assertions.rationale: GoogleIdentityProvider : IdentityProvider defines public const string ProviderType = "google" and passes it to the base constructor.

assertions.assertion: GoogleIdentityProvider uses the indexer pattern (this["ClientId"]) for property storage
assertions.rationale: ClientId and ClientSecret are backed by get => this["ClientId"] / set => this["ClientId"] = value indexers.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddProviderType with GoogleHandler, GoogleOptions, and GoogleIdentityProvider type parameters
Code includes a ConfigureAuthenticationOptions-derived class that maps GoogleIdentityProvider properties to GoogleOptions
assertions.rationale: GoogleDynamicConfigureOptions derives from ConfigureAuthenticationOptions<GoogleOptions, GoogleIdentityProvider> and maps ClientId/ClientSecret onto the GoogleOptions.

assertions.assertion: The configure class sets SignInScheme and CallbackPath on the GoogleOptions
assertions.rationale: Configure sets options.SignInScheme = context.DynamicProviderOptions.SignInScheme and options.CallbackPath = context.PathPrefix + "/signin".
